title: RemoteFM1Metadata.json (schema 1)
description: Card text, screenshot, skin, panel labels and release choice for a firmware in RemoteFM1. Put the file at your repository's root. Guide: https://github.com/Quixotic7/RemoteFM1FW/blob/main/docs/REMOTEFM1-METADATA.md

$schema.description: This schema's URL, so your editor checks the file.

target.description: The release tag to build (e.g. "v1.4.2"; "1.4.2" also matches a "v1.4.2" tag). Read from your default branch, not from the release.

card.description: The firmware's card in RemoteFM1's catalog.

tag.description: A short subtitle under the name. One line.

what.description: One paragraph: what the firmware is and does.

editor.description: Your own web editor / manager page (https). RemoteFM1 opens it wired to the firmware running in the app.

port.description: Your firmware's USB MIDI port name, as its USB descriptor gives it.

image.description: The card picture: PNG, JPEG or WebP, square, at most 1 MiB, 512 x 512 px recommended.

skin.description: A background and colours for RemoteFM1's on-screen FM-1. Needs at least an image or a theme.

background.description: PNG or JPEG, at most 4 MiB, longer side at most 4096 px. Portrait, or any shape; cropped to fill.

landscape.description: Optional image for wide views. Same limits.

dim.description: How much of the faceplate colour goes over the image (0 to 0.8, default 0).

theme.description: Colours as "#RRGGBB": the five main roles, or all fourteen.

labels.description: Fixed names for the panel's buttons and knobs. Upper-cased; "" means the control has no job.

path.description: A file in your repository, relative to its root, with / between folders. No .., no absolute paths, no symlinks.

label.description: 0 to 10 printable ASCII characters (5 or fewer draw best).
